title: Graduated Return After Military Service: the Plan Payment Record
content:
**Rule.** For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a benefit with at least one plan installment line whose lines are all fully credited once plan payments returned on its loan are taken off, and on whose loan plan payments were posted and none was ever returned, adds 2 graduated-return due dates; a benefit with at least one line, all fully credited once returned plan payments are taken off, on whose loan at least one plan payment was returned and made good adds 1; any other benefit adds none. Plan payments posted and returned are those of the hardship plan payment type on the loan's Personal Loans payment ledger.

## Condition table

| Plan installment lines on the benefit | All lines fully credited, net of returned plan payments | Plan payments returned on the loan | Graduated-return due dates added |
|---|---|---|---|
| at least one | yes | none ever, with plan payments posted | 2 |
| at least one | yes | at least one, made good | 1 |
| at least one | no | any | none |
| none | — | — | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- Three lines of 100.00 USD, credited 300.00 USD in total, no plan payment ever returned: 2.
- Same lines, credited 400.00 USD of which 100.00 USD was later returned: net 300.00 USD, every line covered, a return made good: 1.
- Same lines, credited 300.00 USD of which 100.00 USD was later returned: net 200.00 USD, a line not fully credited: none.
